technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with overbought RSI and AO cross-up, but intermediate/long-term structure is weak and ADX lacks conviction; suitable for tactical swing only with tight risk management.

fundamental.summary: GRMN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 118 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no institutional conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (293.76) indicates extreme market fear, though falling DXY provides modest relief for multinationals; earnings in 118 days poses no immediate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI overbought + AO cross-up + supertrend bullish) with price near support (77.81) offers tactical swing entry in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis, contrarian buy signal).
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental collapse (score 3), intermediate trend breakdown (EMA 20/50 bearish, price below EMA50/SMA200), low ADX conviction (20.75), below-average volume, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, recession risk) make this a high-risk momentum trap without structural support.
